# OpenAI Co-Founders: Complete List & Current Affiliations

## The 11 Co-Founders (founded December 8, 2015)

The authoritative list of OpenAI's founding team consists of **11 people**. (Note: Dario and Daniela Amodei are frequently mentioned in OpenAI's early history but are generally classified as **early employees/leaders who joined in 2016**, not members of the founding team — see note at the end.)

| # | Co-Founder | Role at Founding |

| 2 | **Elon Musk** | Co-chair |

---

## Current (2026) Affiliations

**1. Sam Altman — CEO of OpenAI**
Remained at OpenAI; served as full-time CEO since 2019. Briefly ousted and reinstated in November 2023. Still CEO and a board member as of 2026, overseeing OpenAI's IPO preparations (targeted ~2027).

**2. Elon Musk — CEO of Tesla & SpaceX; founder of xAI; owner of X**
Left the OpenAI board in **2018**. Current roles: **CEO of Tesla**, **CEO of SpaceX**, **founder/CEO of xAI** (since 2023, maker of Grok), **owner of X (formerly Twitter)**, plus Neuralink and The Boring Company. He sued OpenAI/Altman (*Musk v. Altman*); a jury **rejected his claims in May 2026** on statute-of-limitations grounds.

**3. Ilya Sutskever — Co-founder & CEO of Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI)**
Left OpenAI in **May 2024**. Co-founded **Safe Superintelligence Inc.** (June 2024) with Daniel Gross and Daniel Levy. When Gross left for Meta (June 2025), **Sutskever became CEO of SSI**. SSI was valued at ~$32B in 2025; **Nvidia announced a $5B investment in SSI in July 2026**.

**4. Greg Brockman — President of OpenAI (continues)**
Still at OpenAI. Listed as **President and "CEO of Applications."** Briefly resigned during the Nov. 2023 crisis and returned; took a sabbatical Aug–Nov 2024. Served on the OpenAI board 2017–2023.

**5. Trevor Blackwell — Y Combinator founder (retired); Anybots founder**
Co-founder of **Y Combinator** (2005) and founder/former CEO of **Anybots** (robotics). Y Combinator's official people page now lists him as **"Founder, Retired."** He is based in **England**. Wikipedia does not show him holding another current operating role.

**6. Vicki Cheung — (last known: co-founder of Gantry)** ⚠️ *Least-documented; 2026 status unverified*
Founding engineer/Head of Infrastructure at OpenAI, left in **2018**. Then software engineer at **Lyft** (2018–2020). In **2020** she co-founded **Gantry**, an ML/LLM monitoring & evaluation startup, with fellow ex-OpenAI engineer Josh Tobin. **I was unable to confirm her 2026 role** with available sources (see caveat below).

**7. Andrej Karpathy — Joined Anthropic (May 2026); founder of Eureka Labs**
OpenAI (2015–2017), then Tesla AI Director (2017–2022), then OpenAI again (2023–2024). Founded **Eureka Labs** (AI education) in July 2024 and coined the term "vibe coding" in 2025. In **May 2026, he joined Anthropic**, leading a pretraining research team.

**8. Durk Kingma — Research Scientist at Anthropic**
Left OpenAI in **2018** for Google Brain (later Google DeepMind), working on generative/text-to-image models. He **joined Anthropic in October 2024** and, per Wikipedia, "currently [is] employed by Anthropic."

**9. John Schulman — Chief Scientist at Thinking Machines Lab**
Left OpenAI in **August 2024** for **Anthropic** (2024–2025), then in **February 2025** joined **Thinking Machines Lab** (Mira Murati's startup) as **Chief Scientist**.

**10. Pamela Vagata — (last known: founder of Pebblebed)** ⚠️ *Least-documented; 2026 status unverified*
Briefly at OpenAI, leaving in **2016** to become an AI tech lead at **Stripe**. She then **founded Pebblebed**, a venture capital firm specializing in early-stage AI investments (established 2021). **I was unable to confirm her 2026 role** with available sources.

**11. Wojciech Zaremba — Continues at OpenAI**
Still at OpenAI (2016–present). Led robotics research, then oversaw GPT models, **GitHub Copilot**, and **Codex**. Described as Head of Language and Code Generation.

## Note on Dario & Daniela Amodei
Frequently surfaced in searches alongside the founders but **not part of the 11-person founding team** (they joined OpenAI in 2016). Current status:
- **Dario Amodei** — Co-founder & **CEO of Anthropic** (left OpenAI 2021)
- **Daniela Amodei** — Co-founder & **President of Anthropic** (left OpenAI 2021)

(Also, **Josh Tobin** was an early OpenAI employee — not a founder — and co-founded Gantry with Vicki Cheung.)
